concurrent_critical_commands.acceptance: same idempotency key converges to one durable business result

worker_saturation.acceptance: worker ownership remains lease-guarded and stale workers cannot complete reclaimed work

retry_storm.acceptance: retryable work is bounded by policy and does not retry indefinitely

queue_backlog.acceptance: dispatcher claims a bounded batch and does not require unbounded in-memory delivery

db_contention.acceptance: critical duplicate contention is serialized by PostgreSQL uniqueness/transactional locking

rate_limiting.acceptance: no distributed ingress rate limiter is added to the kernel without a measured product/edge requirement

graceful_degradation.acceptance: unavailable application dependencies expose bounded HTTP failure rather than false success
